residency.test: Resident if your centre of personal or economic interests is in Poland, or you stay more than 183 days in the year. Either test alone is sufficient.
residency.return_relief: Ulga na powrót exempts up to 85,528 a year for four years for people moving their tax residence to Poland after living abroad.

headline.health_contribution: 9% of income, and it is not deductible
headline.flat_tax_option: the self-employed may elect a 19% flat tax or a lump-sum on revenue

credits.name: Kwota zmniejszająca podatek (tax-reducing amount)
credits.note: the 30,000 tax-free amount expressed as a credit at 12%

standard_deduction.name: Koszty uzyskania przychodu
standard_deduction.note: 250 per month for local employees, 300 per month for those commuting from another town

employee.name: Zdrowotne (health)
employee.note: charged on income after social contributions and, since 2022, not deductible from tax

self_employed.name: ZUS (flat monthly contributions)
self_employed.note: flat monthly base regardless of income; reduced rates apply for the first 30 months of business

capital_gains.rate: 19% flat on capital gains, dividends and interest
capital_gains.reporting: gains on securities are self-assessed on PIT-38 - brokers report but do not withhold
capital_gains.real_estate: 19% on property sold within five calendar years of acquisition; exempt after that, or if proceeds are reinvested in housing within three years
capital_gains.crypto: 19%, reported on PIT-38, with costs deductible only against crypto income

quirks: The 9% health contribution is charged on top of income tax and is not deductible, so the real marginal burden on employment income is well above the headline 12% or 32%.
Under-26s are exempt from income tax on employment and contract income up to 85,528 a year, which makes early-career salaries unusually efficient.

The self-employed choose annually between the progressive scale, a 19% flat tax, and a lump-sum on registered revenue (ryczałt) at rates from 2% to 17%. The right choice can change the effective rate by twenty points.
Joint filing with a spouse effectively doubles the first bracket, which is valuable where one partner earns much more than the other.
Social contributions for the self-employed are a flat monthly amount unrelated to profit, so they are punishing at low income and negligible at high income.

reporting.who_must_file: Every resident with taxable income. Employees have a return pre-prepared in Twój e-PIT which is accepted automatically at the deadline if not amended.

deadlines.what: Twój e-PIT pre-filled returns become available for 2025
Filing and payment deadline for PIT-36, PIT-37 and PIT-38
Employers issue PIT-11 information forms to employees
Advance income tax payments for the self-employed

forms.name: Return for employees and others taxed through withholding agents
Return for business income and foreign income

Capital gains from securities and crypto

documents_to_collect: PESEL or NIP and a trusted profile (profil zaufany) or e-banking login
PIT-11 from every employer and contract payer
Documentation for reliefs: children, internet, rehabilitation, thermal modernisation, donations
IKZE pension contribution certificates, which are deductible
Foreign income statements and proof of foreign tax paid

penalties.late_filing: treated as a fiscal offence; an active regret filing (czynny żal) usually avoids the penalty if made before detection
penalties.late_payment: statutory interest, currently around 14.5% a year
penalties.understatement: fines set in daily rates tied to the minimum wage, and criminal fiscal liability for larger amounts

warnings: The health contribution base for the self-employed differs by tax regime and is not modelled accurately here.
The under-26 exemption and the return relief are not applied automatically.
The middle-class relief was abolished; do not apply figures from 2022 guidance.
